---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new heuristic, feature, or educational enhancement for ARPGuard
title: '[ENHANCEMENT] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or pedagogical limitation is. (e.g., "Students are confused by the raw console output structure when reading anomalies.")

**Which aspect of the lab does this feature target?**
- [ ] **Core Analysis Heuristics** (new attack detection logic, rule adjustments in `code/arpguard_core.py`)
- [ ] **Web Dashboard UI** (visual components, layout upgrades in `code/arpguard_web_dashboard.py`)
- [ ] **Lab Materials & Documentation** (updates to handouts, quiz questions, facilitator blueprints)
- [ ] **Automation / Tooling** (changes to generation setups or integration testing workflows)

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how this change directly benefits learners, instructors, or automated grading pipelines.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear description of any alternative solutions, command configurations, or scripting paths you have evaluated.

**Additional context**
Add any other contextual notes, sample mockups, reference documentation, or related topology ideas here.
